title.narrative: Contribution to the United Nations Post-conflict Multi-donor Trust Fund in Colombia

description.narrative:
The Trust Fund for Sustaining Peace in Colombia supports coordinated responses for stabilization and peacebuilding. Aligned with CONPES 3850 guidelines, the Trust Fund finances thematic priorities that provide transparent, effective, and results-based solutions to immediate and medium-term post-conflict priorities in Colombia.
To ensure national ownership and improved coordination, the United Nations works with the Government of Colombia to mobilize funds for the coordination of interventions that support the national Rapid Response Strategy, early roll-out and scaling-up of agreements that cater to vulnerable communities, and address drivers of conflict as prioritized by national authorities.
The Trust Fund is closely aligned with the national stabilization strategy for Colombia. Strategic objectives support initiatives that:
Increase trust between local communities and authorities, strengthen rule of law and institutional mechanisms, and boost democratic participation in peace processes.
Increase community confidence in peace processes and their transformative potential, particularly for survivors of violence and communities of territories affected by armed conflict.
Avoid and/or mitigate drivers of crime and violence (associated with armed conflict), and reduce the effects of coercion and violence (real and perceived).
Manage community and/or social conflict through early interventions that resolve or transform community demands into dialogue processes and prevent social rifts from expanding.
Achieve early security, justice, and development wins that threaten to undermine peace processes and help stakeholders manage challenges.
